- **Sign in with a passkey (FL-836, FL-859):** local accounts can sign in with a passkey instead of a password. Add or remove passkeys in Settings › Privacy › Passkeys.
- **Connected apps (FL-803, FL-860):** other apps can ask to connect to your Frameleaf account. You see what an app is asking for before you allow it, and Connected apps in Settings lists every app you allowed and lets you remove one.
- **Home Assistant (FL-866):** a custom integration brings Frameleaf into Home Assistant.
- **Frameleaf Assistant search (FL-885, FL-847):** assistants can search your library through Frameleaf and are told why each photo matched.
- **Automations can call a webhook on Frameleaf events (FL-819):** the webhook action can now start from things that happen in Frameleaf, and each call is signed.
- **Restore drill (FL-879, FL-900):** Frameleaf can practise a restore from your backup and give you a signed report. A drill card and a report page show the result, and a monthly email sends it to you.
- **Phones page shows each phone's backup (FL-792):** the Phones page shows what each phone has backed up and why anything is still waiting.
- **Phones can send back more lost photos (FL-1347):** when an original is lost, Frameleaf now asks your phones for photos uploaded by the current apps too, not only older ones, and tells them each photo's size so they can find it even when its name or date has changed.
- **RAW files always import (FL-1355):** RAW files have no size limit. When a RAW file is hard to read, Frameleaf tries several ways to open it and falls back to the camera's own preview.
- **27 more kinds of still image open (FL-1356):** more image file types open and get previews.
- **Design files in Boards (FL-1358):** PSD, PSB, PDF, Illustrator and other design files open in Boards or show their own preview.
- **More videos import and play (FL-1357):** more video containers import, cinema RAW video is kept safe, and Dolby Vision profile 7 plays.
- **Zoom and pan inside videos (FL-801):** you can zoom into a video in the viewer and move around it.
- **People in this album (FL-809):** an album shows the people in it as face chips. Choose one to see only their photos in that album.
- **Archived photos in People, your choice (FL-795):** choose whether archived photos appear in People.
- **People and faces saved in sidecars (FL-927):** Frameleaf can save people and face regions in XMP sidecar files.
- **Copy a direct image link (FL-788):** a share of a single photo can give you a link straight to the image.
- **Recent work is easier to read (FL-1349):** in Settings › Background work › Advanced, each piece of work shows one state and the reason for it, and nightly work is one card. Photos that couldn't be finished are grouped by plain cause, such as a drive that can't be reached or a damaged file, each with one thing to do.
- **Couldn't process, in Things to fix (FL-862):** Library care lists photos and videos Frameleaf couldn't process, in one place.
- **Large videos and old JPEGs are no longer called damaged (FL-1353):** Library care no longer flags some large videos and older JPEG files that are in fact fine.
- **Keep as it is and Try again are respected (FL-1337, FL-1372):** a photo you chose to keep as it is stays that way when a delayed fix runs, Try again runs for delayed fixes, and proven damage keeps being counted while it waits to go to the Trash.
- **Kept photos leave the counts (FL-1347):** a photo you chose to keep as it is no longer counts as missing or damaged, and File checks won't move it to the Trash.
- **Share says when only a preview is left (FL-1347):** in the viewer, Download and Send a copy explain it when a photo's original is missing.
- **Locked protects the files Library care keeps (FL-1364):** when a photo is in Locked with Locked encryption on, the files Library care kept for it are encrypted with it, and opened again when it leaves Locked.
- **Cloud Backup restore on more drives (FL-1347):** an administrator's restore now works on drives that can't make hard links.
- **Cloud Backup shows which accounts are covered (FL-542):** Cloud Backup shows the account coverage the backup service itself reports.
- **Server logs in Command Center (FL-893):** administrators can read the server's logs in Command Center, filter them, follow them live and download them.
- **Settings Overview opens sooner (FL-1376):** the Overview no longer waits for the library report before it opens.
- **Folder layout accepts every Immich pattern tag (FL-1363):** a custom folder pattern brought over from Immich is accepted as it is.
- **A warning before a first password over HTTP (FL-713):** Frameleaf warns you before you set your first local password on an address that isn't secure.
- **Sign-in fixes (FL-850, FL-771, FL-870):** the wait after wrong passwords works correctly behind a proxy, backup receipt counts cover the right photos, and share keys are kept out of the server's logs.
- **Manager opens on Overview (FL-1350):** signing in to Manager opens the Overview, not a half-finished setup screen.
- **Unraid templates for Server and ML (FL-1351):** the Unraid catalog offers manual Server and ML templates.
- **Memory and processor limits are reported (FL-428):** the ML service reports the memory and processor limits of its container.
- **Two-step sign-in (FL-831):** turn on two-step sign-in for your server password and enter the code on the web. Signing in through Frameleaf Cloud already sends an emailed code, so it doesn't ask for another.
- **Date and time format of your own (FL-783):** choose how dates and times look separately from the language.
- **Frameleaf Assistant (FL-763, FL-785, FL-1369):** search and Settings now call it Frameleaf Assistant, and it checks its saved planning data before using it.
- **Search falls back to text (FL-1403, FL-1402):** when search by meaning is off or can't run, Frameleaf searches by text instead of failing, and the search mode switch stays put when a link can't be opened.
- **Search results are easier to scan (FL-1393):** results have a title, one tile per video, and the best matches first.
- **Frameleaf Connect (FL-844):** assistants and other apps can reach Frameleaf through Frameleaf Connect, and webhook calls are signed correctly.
- **Export an album with everything in it (FL-1416):** an album export holds the verified originals, their details and their sidecar files.
- **Keep an album offline from Photos (FL-1417, FL-1413, FL-1432):** on Desktop you can choose an album to keep offline and authorize one local copy from Apple Photos.
- **Review suggestions before they're applied (FL-1415, FL-1418):** on-device captions and photo description drafts wait for you to review them.
- **Smooth Motion and Studio Cloud jobs (FL-1426, FL-1428):** Smooth Motion shows where it will run before you pick a model, signed local models are accepted, and each Studio project shows its own Cloud job receipts.
- **Boards preview more files (FL-1431, FL-1359):** Office documents preview and audio plays in Boards, and fonts in Boards got review fixes.
- **Eagle imports more (FL-1425):** more Eagle libraries import, along with what you saved from the browser.
- **Importing looks calm (FL-1409):** the import screen is quieter, and a scan that was interrupted can be started again.
- **Windows library move recovers (FL-1434):** if moving a Windows library's media is interrupted, Manager finishes or undoes it.
- **People (FL-1383, FL-1384, FL-1385, FL-1419):** better main photos, upright thumbnails, merge suggestions, "Is this all one person?" finds two people held as one, and People refreshes itself while photos still wait for faces.
- **Memories (FL-1394, FL-1408):** a quiet empty day, titles that say how long ago and where, memories after a first import, and a shared on-this-day card.
- **Tidy your albums looks again (FL-1404):** it checks again when albums change, overnight and when you open it.
- **Library toolbar and View menu (FL-1391, FL-1398, FL-1389):** tabs and grouping sit in the toolbar, the selection bar is in a clearer order, the View menu is fuller and remembered for your account, and album headers and the Albums toolbar match the design.
- **Hide Pets (FL-1406):** an account can hide Pets from the sidebar.
- **Activity and Recent work (FL-1388, FL-1430):** the Activity page has a summary, work by feature and one line per finished job, and Recent work shows one card per night with no empty cards.
- **External folders on older Unraid installs (FL-1407):** Manager sets up External folders for Unraid servers installed before 1.2.14.
- **Safer plugin requests (FL-1420):** every step of a plugin's web request is kept away from private network addresses.
- **Steadier maintenance (FL-1443, FL-1424, FL-1438):** a stopped rollback is retried, and Desktop and on-device results are matched to the right photos.
